QuestInfo.name: Call of the Kaiser
QuestInfo.0: You suddenly hear a male voice. What the... Is it the previous Kaiser?
QuestInfo.1: You can hear the previous Kaiser's voice. He said he's been waiting to speak to you. Now he wants you to...accept his Essence? What is going on?
QuestInfo.2: You received the Essence of the previous Kaiser. His will is yours now!
